successCases.question: 给我做一份人力资源相关的统计分析
successCases.sql: select `a`.`did`, count(*) as `employee_count` from `oa_admin` `a` where `a`.`status` = 1 group by `a`.`did` order by `employee_count` desc;

successCases.question: 给我做一份人力资源相关的统计分析
successCases.sql:
SELECT `d`.`from_did`, `d`.`to_did`, COUNT(*) AS `transfer_count`, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS `total_transfers`
FROM `oa_department_change` `d`
WHERE `d`.`move_time` >= 1767196800 AND `d`.`move_time` <= 1774108799
GROUP BY `d`.`from_did`, `d`.`to_did`
ORDER BY `transfer_count` DESC;

successCases.question: 给我做一份人力资源相关的统计分析
successCases.sql:
SELECT `a`.`did`, COUNT(*) AS `count`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `oa_personal_quit` `p2` JOIN `oa_admin` `a2` ON `p2`.`uid` = `a2`.`id` WHERE `p2`.`quit_time` >= 1767196800 AND `p2`.`quit_time` <= 1774108799) AS `total_count`
FROM `oa_personal_quit` `p`
JOIN `oa_admin` `a` ON `p`.`uid` = `a`.`id`
WHERE `p`.`quit_time` >= 1767196800 AND `p`.`quit_time` <= 1774108799
GROUP BY `a`.`did`;

successCases.question: 给我做一份人力资源相关的统计分析
successCases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM `oa_admin` WHERE `status` = 1 AND `entry_time` < 1774022400;

successCases.question: 给我做一份人力资源相关的统计分析
successCases.sql:
SELECT 
  d.`title` AS `department_title`,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN a.`status` = 1 THEN 1 END) AS `current_active_count`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN dc.`move_time` >= 1767225600 AND dc.`move_time` <= 1774108799 THEN dc.`id` END) AS `q1_2026_transfer_count`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pq.`quit_time` >= 1767225600 AND pq.`quit_time` <= 1774108799 THEN pq.`id` END) AS `q1_2026_quit_count`,
  a.`type`,
  a.`is_staff`
FROM `oa_admin` a
LEFT JOIN `oa_department` d ON a.`did` = d.`id`
LEFT JOIN `oa_department_change` dc ON a.`id` = dc.`uid`
LEFT JOIN `oa_personal_quit` pq ON a.`id` = pq.`uid`
GROUP BY d.`title`, a.`type`, a.`is_staff`;
